milestones.name: Putting down roots
milestones.explain: Start where people meet: a community garden on Hollin Square, a wildflower meadow somewhere in the village, and a village that reaches satisfaction 62.

milestones.name: Warm homes
milestones.explain: Old cottages lose heat through every wall. Retrofit homes in two parts of the village and lift average energy coverage to 0.7.

milestones.name: Across the brook
milestones.explain: The footbridges are the village's lifelines. Run a bus line across the brook, make the streets safe in two places and reach town satisfaction 64.
